narrative.overview:
Myhabit uses warm cream, quiet sage and restrained terracotta to make daily routines easy to scan. Anuphan carries both Thai and English with the same welcoming, readable character.

Light and dark are complete versions of one shared system. Flat surfaces, fine borders and generous space establish hierarchy; color marks actions, selected states and recorded progress.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream and sage surfaces with restrained terracotta actions.
Anuphan throughout Thai and English interfaces.
Flat containers, clear rows and visible interaction states.
Responsive desktop sidebar and mobile bottom navigation.

rules.name: The Shared Theme Rule
rules.body: Every module uses the global system, light or dark preference and the same semantic color roles.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Use borders, space and tonal layering to distinguish regions; shared surfaces have no shadow.
Use shared fast/state timing and ease-out for action feedback. Fine-pointer hover stays restrained; reduced motion removes movement and loops. Loading rotation runs only during loading.
rules.name: The Action Motion Rule

dos: Do use shared semantic CSS variables in both themes.
Do keep habit progress distinct from tasks, goals, focus and mood.
Do retain visible focus, descriptive labels and reduced-motion support.
Do keep Thai and English copy readable when content wraps.
donts: Don't replace real habit counts or streaks with decorative progress.
Don't use excessive shadows, motion or decorative color blocks.
